context: Request: the full list of general-litigation matters where the firm sought fee-shifting, with the underlying documents. Rubric: fourteen matters (1006-00005, 1008-00007, 1010-00005, 1012-00006, 1019-00005, 1020-00005, 1021-00006, 1023-00002, 1024-00003, 1027-00003, 1033-00006, 1035-00004, 1038-00007, 1044-00006), each with proof documents, plus a precision criterion. All runs listed many other matters (e.g. sibling matters 1008-00005, 1035-00003, 1038-00006 and others such as 1005-00004, 1011-00003).

stages.stage: List files in the document store

stages.note: declared: List files in the document store (attempt 2). Counts matter folders and files by type.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide extraction script for fee terms, patched to run by matter range; five parallel range runs write hit files, four of them time out; the review flags the timeouts.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Reopened: checks the last line of each hit file and filters the saved hits by request phrases and litigation-type paths (outputs of about 93K, 36K and 142K characters).

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Reopened: counts the matters with hits per range file (196 of 266) and treats the rest as having none.

stages.note: Reads the openings of pleadings, motions and briefs from about twenty candidates, then greps the saved hits for named files and matters.

runs.failure_point: Four of its five range scans timed out and their partial hit files were treated as complete, so four needed matters never surfaced; three that did surface were never opened; the answer listed many other matters.

first_error.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
first_error.why: Four of the five parallel range scans timed out and left partial hit files, which it later treated as complete; four needed matters never appeared in any output.
first_error.critic_note: (generic flag) the review at [29] flagged that six of seven runs timed out and completion was never seen; the agent only checked the files' last lines and counted matters, and the review at [39] repeated the coverage doubt.

other_errors.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
other_errors.why: Three needed matters appeared in its filtered hit lists at [33]-[35], but the documents it chose to read came from other matters and those three were never opened.
other_errors.critic_note: (specific flag) the review at [75] named one of them among matters never opened.

other_errors.why: The answer lists many matters beyond those requested, including sibling matters read at [48]-[64] in place of the needed ones, on pleading skims and grep hits.
other_errors.critic_note: (generic flag) the write review at [81] raised 'possible over-inclusion from keyword hits and snippets'; the check stages only fixed paths.

first_error.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
first_error.why: The bounded scan at [24]-[25] listed hits for all needed matters, but the 28 documents it chose to read left out three of them, which were never opened later either.
first_error.critic_note: (specific flag) the review at [91] named one of the three among surfaced matters never opened; the agent went on to write.

other_errors.critic_note: (generic flag) the write review at [97] flagged 'over-inclusion from keyword hits, snippets or short skims'; the check stage only fixed a citation.

runs.failure_point: Four needed matters surfaced in its scans but were never opened, it dropped one it had read in favour of a sibling matter, and it listed many other matters.

first_error.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
first_error.why: Its per-matter aggregation at [40]-[41] listed four needed matters, but the candidates it chose to read here and later left them out and they were never opened.
first_error.critic_note: (generic flag) the review at [86] flagged that the candidate set was fixed early and surfaced matters were left unread, naming none of the four.

other_errors.why: Both sibling matters of one client were read at [57]-[68], but the answer lists only the other sibling.
other_errors.critic_note: (generic flag) the write review at [104] raised possible under-inclusion and misattributed matter numbers without naming the matter.

other_errors.why: The answer lists many matters beyond those requested, on scan snippets and skims from [38]-[94].
other_errors.critic_note: (generic flag) the write review at [104] raised a 'risk of over-inclusion'; the check stage only fixed paths.

divergence: All three runs failed the same way at two points: needed matters that surfaced in their scans were never opened (first error in T1 and T2, a later error in T0), and the answer listed far more matters than requested, including sibling matters of the same clients (over-inclusion in all three). T0 failed first and worst at its scan: four of five parallel range scans timed out, it accepted the partial hit files, and four needed matters never surfaced at all. The critic flagged the timeouts (only partly acted on), named one unopened matter specifically in T0 and T1 (ignored), and raised over- and under-inclusion only generically.
